headline: Christmas approaches amid colors, but buyers are scarce
summary: Christmas decorations are appearing across Santo Domingo, but buyers are scarce in major commercial avenues. Street vendors are reporting weak footfall during the traditionally busy season.
why: Holiday retail sales are a key indicator of consumer spending, which drives a large share of economic activity in the Dominican Republic.
original_headline: La Navidad se acerca entre colores, pero escasean los compradores
